DPR-09: live-reference recovery evidence

Test A limitation: these browser cases begin with a saved-null report plus existing live BOQ references. They do not prove the literal sequence of reopening an empty saved-null report and adding its first item: the required no-reference/no-picker rule prevents that step. This needs a separate behavior decision.

All screenshots use real DPR controls with synthetic fixture API responses and browser storage. No production/customer writes. Guided automatically links the existing row to programme context, so its linked-context summary replaces the picker in the captured state. Detailed/Edit shows the picker.

  • Standard suite: 204 files, 3,376 tests passed. Production build passed.
